subject.title: improve(diagnostics): surface run startup phases as session-correlated events

question: Should `run.execution_phase` become a supported long-term public diagnostic/plugin-SDK event, with its phase vocabulary and correlation semantics treated as an external contract?
rationale: The patch is additive and appears mechanically sound, but no supplied maintainer decision establishes that these embedded-runner internals should be committed to the public SDK indefinitely.

options.title: Sponsor the public diagnostic event
options.body: Merge the PR and treat the documented event name, payload, asynchronous delivery, and session-correlation behavior as a supported additive diagnostic contract.

options.title: Keep phase telemetry owner-local
options.body: Do not merge this public SDK expansion; retain or design any startup-phase visibility within a diagnostics owner surface that does not freeze the embedded-runner phase vocabulary for plugins.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the public diagnostic event
recommendation.body: Merge the PR and treat the documented event name, payload, asynchronous delivery, and session-correlation behavior as a supported additive diagnostic contract.

likelyOwner.reason: An owner of the current diagnostics and plugin-SDK contract should decide whether the new public event is durable product surface.
